mcp.title: Agent access (MCP)
mcp.subtitle: Reserved. This page holds the Steward MCP server's settings once that server exists.
mcp.reservedDescription: The MCP server is still an idea. Behind this switch, this page will hold the on/off setting, the endpoint to give agents, which scopes agents may use at all, the longest a token may live, and an audit view of agent calls across people. On an appliance it is configured on the box and shown read-only here.
mcp.tokens: People register their own agent tokens in their profile (Security), with a name, scope and expiry, shown once. A token acts as that person with that person's rights, never more. A site administrator can revoke anyone's token from here.
